text: ほんば　きょうと　では　だいもんじ　とか　おくりび　と　よんで　いるのだ！

structure.jp: ほんば　きょうと　では
だいもんじ　とか　おくりび　と
structure.en: things like Fire Blast (Daimonji) or Okuribi

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.explanation: とか after a word gives it as one example among others, like 'things like A or B'. だいもんじ とか おくりび = 'Daimonji or Okuribi, for example'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end adds a tone of firmly explaining how things really are. よんで いるのだ = 'the fact is, they call it that'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows something people keep doing as a habit. よんで いる = 'they call it'.
